page.notes: Doubtful readings: "ante" (printed "aute"); "doctissimi" (printed word unclear, reads like "doctifemper"); "auctior" (the ct ligature looks like "ft"). Long s is written as plain s throughout, so "Teft." is "Test.", "fint" is "sint", "defiderari" is "desiderari". The macrons over "inchoatū" and "perfectū" are read from the scan. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. Ornament dots and dashes in the margins are not transcribed as text.
